_comment: Copy to your repo root as .appstore-precheck.json. Every key is OPTIONAL; the scanner auto-detects a standard fastlane + Xcode layout. Use 'auto' or omit a key to keep auto-detection.
_dynamic_comment: Opt-in build/run defaults. This file lives in the scanned repo, so build:true is ONLY honoured when the invoker sets APPSTORE_PRECHECK_TRUST_CONFIG=1 (otherwise it is ignored with a stderr notice; pass --build instead). demoLogin only applies when a build or --app run is already active and launches the app.
